cases.heading: Platform Engineer
cases.text:
Example Labs is hiring a full-time Platform Engineer. Remote within Canada only. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada. We do not offer visa sponsorship. No salary range is published.
Build reliable data services in Python. A degree or equivalent practical experience is accepted. Rust is preferred, not required.

cases.heading: Data Engineer
cases.text:
Example Labs is hiring a Data Engineer for Toronto or Berlin. Toronto base pay is CAD 120,000–150,000 per year. Berlin base pay is EUR 70,000–90,000 per year. Equity is separate. Full-time, hybrid: two days each week in the relevant office.
Build batch and streaming data systems. Three years of SQL and Python experience required. Travel up to 10% is required. Applications close 2026-12-01.

cases.heading: Operations Engineer
cases.text: Confidential employer is seeking an Operations Engineer in Dublin, Ireland. This is a six-month contract with possible extension, not guaranteed. Maintain Linux services and respond to incidents. Weekend on-call once per month is required. Compensation is EUR 60 per hour. No university degree is required. Two years of Linux experience is required.

cases.heading: Systems Engineer
cases.text: Example Labs seeks a full-time Systems Engineer in Denver, Colorado. Hybrid with four office days each week. USD 100,000–130,000 base per year; equity separate. Active TS/SCI clearance required. Must be willing to take a polygraph. No sponsorship. US work authorization required. Travel up to 25%. Applications close 2026-12-15. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience accepted. Five years of systems experience required. Build C++ services. Rust preferred. Must complete a skills assessment. Night on-call one week each month. Must work Mountain Time hours. Relocation assistance is not available. AI assistance during interviews is prohibited unless explicitly permitted.
